name: Cullen Roche
zh_summary: Housing demand surged due to constrained supply, falling rates, and Covid one-time jump from work from home. About $330k of gain is inflation and $1.2M real appreciation. Own land where more people want to live now than in 2014.
en_summary: Housing demand surged due to constrained supply, falling rates, and Covid one-time jump from work from home. About $330k of gain is inflation and $1.2M real appreciation. Own land where more people want to live now than in 2014.
text: The demand for housing surged over this period because supply was constrained, rates fell and then Covid caused a massive one time jump in demand from work from home. So the basic economics is that about $330k of your gain is just inflation and the other $1.2M or so is real appreciation. You own land in a place a lot more people want to live today than in 2014, and that's what got captured as the gain. Congrats!
